issues.summary: Container PSSU4527862 (HBL MFCIM260009) stayed at the terminal past the 16 March 2026 free-time expiry because the consignee's cold storage was full, and Pacific Star declined the late extension request, resulting in 4 days of demurrage invoiced at USD 1,120.

decisions.summary: Pacific Star Shipping declined the 5-day free-time extension for PSSU4527862 because the request arrived on the expiry day, so demurrage accrues from 17 March 2026.
Meridian will absorb 50% (USD 560) of the USD 1,120 demurrage on PSSU4527862 and bill the remaining USD 560 to Blue Harbor Foods.

tasks.summary: Send Bora Jung a settlement letter explaining the 50/50 split of the USD 1,120 demurrage on PSSU4527862.
Book Meridian's USD 560 share of the demurrage for PSSU4527862.

deadlines.what: Pacific Star Shipping 10-day free time expiry for container PSSU4527862.
